elements.label: Actor striding toward camera
elements.change_other: live-action actor walks briskly toward and across camera, growing in frame with hair swinging

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Harmonic stack continuing the score; onset lands as the walk begins but is not a designed effect.

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Same stacked-partial shape as the surrounding score with no visual hit at that moment; reads as a music note rather than a chime SFX.

pattern.description: Wide live-action office shot: a locked-off camera while the actor walks purposefully toward and past the lens on the right side of frame, the rest of the office static.
pattern.why_premium: Cinematic framing (letterbox, wide symmetrical office, actor walking into the lens) gives the story beat real production value and urgency before any UI is shown.

build_hint.gsap: Not a motion-graphics build: drop the filmed clip as a <video> layer on the HyperFrames timeline with no tween; cut on the actor's stride and let any overlay enter afterwards via gsap.fromTo(overlay, {opacity:0}, {opacity:1, duration:0.4, ease:'power2.out'}).
build_hint.remotion: Place the clip in <OffthreadVideo> inside a <Sequence> with no interpolation; time the next cut to the frame where the actor fills the right third.

notes: Live-action footage; camera.move none, so the pan/scale sums are the actor moving inside the frame. x082 falls 385 ms after the burst; label is uncertain between music and chime.
